item.title: Apple Foundation Models
item.description:

item.title: What the Fuck Happened to Nerds
item.description:

item.title: Openrouter Fusion API
item.description:
📝 OpenRouter: Fusionopenrouter/fusionComparePlaygroundFusion turns your prompt into a small multi-model deliberation. Because Fusion runs every panel member plus a judge call, your request is priced as the sum of those underlying completions rather than a single model. OpenRouter: FusionComparePlaygroundQuick StartDrop-in code to call this model.
🔗 Read more: https://openrouter.ai/openrouter/fusion

item.title: Belgian politicians would rather risk treason charges than trust engineers
item.description:
📝 They would assume that they are safer with Google, and this was a rational assumption. And I am happy to never have been in that situation. Between the geopolitical risk and the very real risk of empowering their own IT, our politicians decided they are willing to take the geopolitical risk.
🔗 Read more: http://mikhailian.mova.org/node/325

item.title: Curl will not accept vulnerability reports during July 2026
item.description:
📝 The curl project will not accept or otherwise handle any vulnerability reports during the month of July 2026. Summer of bliss starts: July 1, 2026. Some of us may spend some of this time to see other places.
🔗 Read more: https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2026/06/15/curl-summer-of-bliss/
